id.description: Internal ID of the evidence record.

transactionCode.description: Unique transaction code for the identification process.

accountId.description: Internal account ID associated with the identification.

workflowId.description: Internal workflow ID used for the identification process.

status.description: Current status of the identification process.

pendingReview.description: Present if the identification is pending manual review, otherwise null.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the identification was created.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the identification evidence expires.

startedAt.description: Timestamp when the identification process was started by the signer.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the identification process was completed. Null if not yet completed.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp when the identification was reviewed. Null if not reviewed.
